tasks.title: Hash only what a stage consumes, not its whole definition
tasks.why: consumed_hash (pipeline.py:224) hashes the whole stage dict bar 'notes', so editing bands, station, outputs or role makes a new job id and throws away a PASS: the stage goes STALE and a desktop capture or Blender stage is re-run for nothing. stations.md warns only about role. It bites now: decisions.md:166 asks for a band on the stages that name none (six stages on the board have no bands), and giving them one re-runs each.
tasks.done_when: a case in test_pipeline.py adds a band to a DONE stage and the state stays DONE, while an inputs or lane change still goes STALE

tasks.title: Make complete check the evidence folder layout, not just path existence
tasks.why: cmd_complete (pipeline.py:383-388) accepts any path on the board for a band. The skill (driving-and-evidence.md, 'Evidence on the board') and the relay's own checker (Tools/relay/sources/pipeline.py:114,141-152) require evidence/<item>/<stage>/<band>.jpg with a <band>.json sidecar and a frames.txt line; stations.md's complete example says --evidence t1=evidence/<item>/t1.jpg, one folder short. A station worker's hand PASS is then evidence the critic cannot read and the relay would have failed: the capture is shot twice.
tasks.done_when: a case in test_pipeline.py where a PASS with evidence/t1.jpg is refused and one with evidence/crate/sim/t1.jpg + sidecar + frames.txt passes; the stations.md example says the same path

tasks.title: Refuse a detached restart while the recorded child still runs
tasks.why: cmd_start (run_detached.py:59) refuses only RUNNING and STALLED. A wrapper that died leaves CRASHED with 'child still running (stop it or wait)' (state, run_detached.py:124-128), and a start is allowed: two gates or two Unity batch jobs on one checkout, both red, an hour gone. test_pipeline.py has no case for run_detached.py at all.
tasks.done_when: a case writes a run.json with a dead wrapper_pid and a live child (a sleep it started), and start exits non-zero naming stop

tasks.title: Make the commit-headroom floor the default, not a flag to remember
tasks.why: --min-headroom-gb defaults to 0 (run_detached.py:163), so the guard is off unless the caller types it, while four places tell agents to type --min-headroom-gb 10 every single time (pipeline/SKILL.md:93, driving-and-evidence.md:24, tw-gym/SKILL.md:73, pipelines.md:219). One forgotten flag starts a gate at 3 GB headroom and Windows kills the editors.
tasks.done_when: a test_pipeline.py case asserts the parser default is 10 and that start refuses with headroom_gb patched below it, --min-headroom-gb 0 being the way out

tasks.title: Drop text=True from refuse_in_leg's git call
tasks.why: pipeline.py:352 reads git with text=True, against this file's own docstring (line 23) and workflow.md:578: on a non-ASCII checkout path the marker path is mangled, the relay-leg check silently finds no marker, and a leg may claim a job its runner should.
tasks.done_when: grep -c "text=True" trench-warfare-3d/Tools/pipeline/*.py is 0 and selftest.py's two 'refuses inside a relay leg' cases stay green
